verdict.rationale: Kling documents a RESTful API with JWT auth and production endpoints, a quickstart to call the API, and an agent-facing MCP/CLI, so an agent can plausibly submit generation jobs from the docs. Per-unit USD pricing tables let it estimate cost, but nothing shows how to poll job status, retrieve the finished asset, or read actual cost or credits consumed per job. The quickstart is also purchase-first, with no sandbox or OpenAPI artifact. Missing for 10: documented task-status/polling or callback for watching jobs, documented asset-retrieval step, per-job cost or credit reporting in API responses, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent run.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can run the full video loop from docs alone: submit the prompt, watch the job, fetch the asset, and report the cost

citations.quote: RESTful API with JWT-based authentication (AccessKey + SecretKey)
